verdict.rationale: Asking whether an authenticator app or 2FA API can be driven by natural-language commands is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence pack never mentions natural-language, conversational, or assistant-driven operation. The documented interfaces are the mobile and desktop app UI and an SDK/API, and the probe notes the API is closed to new customers. Neither is natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
